name: brace-store
description: A SvelteKit storefront built twice, in BraceML and HTML, with a NestJS/Prisma/SQLite API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev:html: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend-html run dev"
